text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Vietnam will develop in-depth external relations next year while holding fast to its independence, self-reliance, national character, political regime and socialist orientation.
-- A U.S. science and technology delegation is visiting Vietnam this week to discuss cooperation in information technology, health, and environmental management.
-- The National Assembly's Economy and Budget Committee says poor management of the economy has led to unsustainable growth.
-- The standing board of the Hanoi Party Committee has issued a directive calling for the reinforcing of an anti-drugs campaign in schools and colleges.
-- Some 25 people have died, 69,850 others are in need of help and more than 9,300 families have been evacuated from flooded areas of Dong Thap province in the Mekong Delta.
